thread:
emily: Starter app fails on first API call after invite. curl returns 402 Payment Required on /v1/chat/completions. anyone seen this? :confused:

raj: which org and sample?

emily: org: org-acme-qa, sample: node-starter. repro curl below:

emily: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'`
# => 402 {"error":"workspace_payment_required","message":"Attach payment method or enable trial"}

olivia: 402 suggests billing gating. did the user join via SSO invite or direct signup?

emily: SSO invite. console showed no trial prompt after accept.

olivia: filing console ticket. known edge where SSO-provisioned invites don't set trial=true. billing team can flip temporarily.

billing-bot: Billing update: trial enabled for org-acme-qa by olivia. allow ~20s for propagation.

emily: re-run after 30s  success, 200 and tokens used. :tada:

emily: follow-ups: 1) console should surface trial CTA for SSO invites 2) API 402 should include console link hint e.g. /console/orgs/org-acme-qa/billing 3) SDK should raise a BillingRequiredError class instead of generic HTTPError

raj: noted. will add a one-line README note in starter samples and a devex CLI helper `redwood orgs enable-trial <org>` for admins.

emily: thanks, tagging @platform-sre in case routing rules intersect.

onboard-bot: created case #5801 "SSO invite missing trial flag" assigned: olivia, console-team.
